pagination.tokenShape: cursor 是对象 {previous,next}，每个值是 base64(JSON {id:<锚点消息 id>, order:"asc|desc", direction:"previous|next"})
pagination.workingProtocol: 标量 `?limit=N&cursor=<token>`，**不带 order**，以 data.length===0 判停（空页仍返回 token，不能靠 token 消失判停）
proof: 20 条历史 / limit=3 → 7 页覆盖 20/20
翻页途中并发写入 → 261/261，不丢不重
traps: cursor[previous]= / cursor[next]= 的 deepObject 形态被**静默忽略**：每页返回同一默认页且不报错（本轮前两次走查即被此误导）
cursor 与 order 同时给 → 400 InvalidCursorError "Cursor cannot be combined with order"（与 Mac 2.0.22 一致）
锚点不存在（msg_nonexi…_000）→ 200 返回最近一页，不报错 → 非法游标不可依赖服务端校验
limit>200 → 400 "Expected a value less than or equal to 200"；0/-1 → 400；1.5 → 400 "Expected an integer"
types=user 等类型过滤参数被接受但**完全不过滤**（返回全部类型）

verdicts: hard limit 20,971,520 bytes for BOTH file:// and data: channels (corrects round 4 “no ceiling observed”)

handoverModel.finding: a queued item is consumed inside the SAME execution as the turn before it: the session record holds only ONE idle for two prompts, and session.active never falls back to false between them
handoverModel.evidence: logs/ext17_handover_race.json (3/3 rounds identical; turn2AutoStart never observed because there is no boundary)
handoverModel.consequence: there is no "old turn ended, new turn not yet started" window to interrupt safely

lateInterruptKillsNewerTurn.method: wait until turn 1 assistant answer text exists (so the queued turn 2 is already running its sleep 20), confirm GET .../message/{queuedId} == 200, then fire interrupt
lateInterruptKillsNewerTurn.verdict: CONFIRMED (3/3): an interrupt intended for turn 1 kills turn 2 instead; turn 2 leaves no answer, its user message stays permanently in the record followed by an empty assistant[error] and idle:"interrupted"
lateInterruptKillsNewerTurn.why: POST /api/session/{id}/interrupt accepts only sessionID (+resume query) - there is no turn/message identifier, so it always acts on whatever the session is running now
productRequirement: label interrupt as "stop the current execution (possibly the message that was just queued)"
re-read which user message is currently executing before sending interrupt
after an interrupt, honestly show queued-but-unanswered turns instead of implying they were never sent
